top_signals.title: FBI Probes Service Selling 153M+ Drivers Licenses
top_signals.summary: A new identity theft service launched on the dark web this week is selling digital scans of more than 153 million drivers licenses from people in the United States and Canada. Based on interviews with individuals whose licenses are available for purchase on this service, it appears to be siphoning images collected by a widely-used identity verification company based in Louisiana. KrebsOnSecurity also has learned that the New Orleans field office of the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) today launched an official inquiry into the source of the images.

top_signals.title: Brazil Hands Government Control Over Mining Deals
top_signals.summary: Brazil's Congress passed a bill Wednesday letting the government block foreign takeovers of mining companies and scrutinize who gets access to the country's mineral reserves…the thing is, though...Brazil still can't turn its rare earth ore into a single magnet, and won't be able to for years. The Senate approved PL 2.780/2024 by voice vote, sending it to President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva for signature. It creates a national policy on critical and strategic minerals, a guarantee fund starting at 2 billion reais, about $393 million,…
